about.title: Marily Valkijainen
about.lede: I'm an artist who loves capturing the beauty and spirit of animals through vibrant portraits and illustrations. My work blends bold, vivid colors with a playful, naive style that brings each piece to life with energy and warmth. I also enjoy experimenting with abstract art, where I let my imagination run wild. Every brushstroke reflects my passion for color, nature, and creating art that radiates positivity and joy.
